caption: The drawing depicts a circular plate with a decorative floral pattern in the center. The outer edge of the plate is lined with a reddish-brown border, blending slightly into a yellow-beige background that fills the interior of the circle. The floral design features a prominent central flower composed of several rounded and tear-drop shaped petals in shades of brown and red, with green accents. Surrounding the central flower are three smaller buds or flowers, each consisting of a combination of green and brown or reddish petals, with some having pointed tips and others being more rounded. Interspersed among the flowers are leaves in varying shades of green, some with visible veins. The stems of the flowers and leaves are thin and brown, connecting the botanical elements into an integrated motif. The plate is centered on a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or patterns present.
title: Pa. German Plate
